test.name: Test Node B Responds To Wiper Command

kw.name: Clear Bus Queue
kw.doc: Clears any lingering messages from the virtual bus buffer.

kw.name: Node A Send Command
kw.doc: Node A (Tester) encodes and broadcasts a command signal onto the bus.

kw.name: Node B Receive And Respond
kw.doc: Simulates Node B behavior: 1. Listens for Node A's command. 2. Validates it. 3. Sends back a response status message (SW Module for Managing Wipers activation).

kw.name: Tester Receive Node B Response
kw.doc: Tester listens for Node B's response frame to verify Node B's behavior.

kw.name: Should Be Equal As Numbers
kw.doc: Fails if objects are unequal after converting them to real numbers.

test.doc: Node A sends a 'Slow' command; Node B receives it and replies with 'Slow' status.
